content.bridge_context: We apply our knowledge of numbers to large-scale operations, like calculating the daily milk production of a dairy farm.

units.title: Large Number Multiplication
units.explanation: Multiplying 3-digit and 4-digit numbers using the expanded form or column method.
units.dual_language_instruction: Perform column multiplication. / कॉलम गुणा करें।

units.title: Estimating Results
units.explanation: Rounding numbers to the nearest tens or hundreds to quickly guess the answer.
units.dual_language_instruction: Round and estimate. / सन्निकट और अनुमान लगाएं।
